facts.statement: The genus name Micropachycephalosaurus has 23 letters, making it the longest dinosaur genus name.
facts.quote: It has the longest name of any dinosaur, with 23 letters in the genus name alone

facts.statement: The holotype specimen IVPP V5542 was found on a cliff southwest of Laiyang in Shandong Province, China.
facts.quote: The holotype, IVPP V5542 was found on a cliff southwest of Laiyang, Shandong Province, near Hongtuyan train station

facts.statement: Dong Zhiming named and described Micropachycephalosaurus in 1978.
facts.quote: The remains were named and described by Dong Zhiming in 1978

facts.statement: Micropachycephalosaurus likely grew to a maximum length of 1 meter.
facts.quote: Micropachycephalosaurus likely only grew up to 1 m long when fully grown
it was a bipedal and herbivorous dinosaur

facts.statement: Micropachycephalosaurus lived in China during the Campanian stage of the Late Cretaceous.
facts.quote: It lived in China during the Late Cretaceous (Campanian) and was found in the Jiangjunding Formation

facts.statement: Micropachycephalosaurus lived in a fluvial to lacustrine environment.
facts.quote: The Jiangjunding Formation was deposited in a fluvial to lacustrine environment

facts.statement: Micropachycephalosaurus lived in the understory, close to the ground.
facts.quote: Micropachycephalosaurus vivía en el sotobosque, es decir, a ras del suelo

facts.statement: Micropachycephalosaurus likely nibbled on leaves and roots rather than swallowing large amounts of vegetation.
facts.quote: En lugar de engullir muchos vegetales, mordisqueaba hojas y raíces

facts.statement: Researchers suggest Micropachycephalosaurus may have had striped skin to camouflage among plants.
facts.quote: Es probable que Micropachycephalosaurus haya tenido piel rayada para poder camuflarse entre las plantas

facts.statement: A 2011 cladistic analysis classified Micropachycephalosaurus as a basal member of the Ceratopsia.
facts.quote: A cladistic analysis performed by Butler et al. (2011) showed that Micropachycephalosaurus is a basal member of the Ceratopsia

facts.statement: A 2024 phylogenetic analysis recovered Micropachycephalosaurus as a basal pachycephalosaur, contradicting earlier classifications.
facts.quote: Phylogenetic analyses by Fonseca et al. (2024) instead recovered this taxon as a basal pachycephalosaur

facts.statement: Micropachycephalosaurus lived approximately 77 million years ago during the Late Cretaceous.
facts.quote: Su período fue el Cretácico tardío, 77 millones de años atrás

facts.statement: Based on its non-domed skull, open supratemporal fenestra, and descended quadratojugal, Micropachycephalosaurus was originally recognized as a member of the Homalocephalidae.
facts.quote: Micropachycephalosaurus se clasifica por su cráneo que no es abovedado, mantiene una ventana supratemportal abierta, y un hueso cuadrado débil anteriormente descendido se reconoce como de la familia Homalocephalidae

facts.statement: The Paleobiology Database records the time range of Micropachycephalosaurus as the Coniacian to Santonian (89.8 to 83.6 million years ago).
facts.quote: Time range: Coniacian to Santonian (89.8 to 83.6 million years ago)

rejected.statement: Micropachycephalosaurus is an extinct genus of basal marginocephalian dinosaur.
rejected.quote: Micropachycephalosaurus (meaning "small thick-headed lizard") is an extinct genus of basal marginocephalian dinosaur
rejected.reason: statement copies the source wording: 'is an extinct genus of basal marginocephalian dinosaur'

rejected.statement: Micropachycephalosaurus measured about 0.5 meters in length and weighed approximately 20 kilograms.
rejected.quote: Micropachycephalosaurus medía medio metro de largo, de hecho siendo uno de los dinosaurios más pequeños, pesaba 20 kilogramos
